```yaml
name: Gitbook Docs Release
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*.*.*"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: "Tag to process (e.g., v3.3.9)"
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.tag != '')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Gitbook config
        run: |
          echo "Creating .gitbook.yaml"
          cat > .gitbook.yaml << EOF
          root: ./docs/gitbook
          EOF

      - name: Extract version components
        id: version
        run: |
          TAG_NAME="${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref }}"
          TAG_NAME=${TAG_NAME#refs/tags/}
          echo "tag_name=$TAG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
          # Extract major.minor version
          MAJOR_MINOR=$(echo "$TAG_NAME" | sed -E 's/v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+/\1\.\2/')
          echo "major_minor=$MAJOR_MINOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
          # Check if it's a minor release (x.y.0)
          IS_MINOR_RELEASE=$(echo "$TAG_NAME" | grep -E "^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.0$")
          echo "is_minor_release=$IS_MINOR_RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create or update docs branch
        run: |
          git checkout -B "docs/v${{ steps.version.outputs.major_minor }}" "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag_name }}"
          git push --force origin "docs/v${{ steps.version.outputs.major_minor }}"

      - name: Create Gitbook variant (if minor release)
        if: steps.version.outputs.is_minor_release != ''
        env:
          GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
        run: |
          VARIANT_NAME="V${{ steps.version.outputs.major_minor }} - Rocky Romp"
          curl -X POST "https://api.gitbook.com/spaces/${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}/variants" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITBOOK_TOKEN}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "name": "'"$VARIANT_NAME"'",
              "path": "docs/v${{ steps.version.outputs.major_minor }}",
              "status": "active"
            }'
```
